title: Order Editing - don't let features get deleted

comments_data.body:
Hmm, I think I can see how this would work. But, I think it needs to be updated on modified.  I could start out with 4 points, and this would allow node removal. But, I could then delete 3 of the points.

I _Think_ we need to track changes - and control the property according to the number of points on the line.

Hi, I just tested this in the deployment, and it's not a valid solution:
- log in as MTG1
- switch to Orders tab
- filter to "My orders"
- open "ASW Barrier"
- click "Edit"
- go down to "Location", click on "Edit"
- start to delete points from a route line (via right-click)
- it is possible to get down to two points, and then delete one of them. which makes the line disappear

I _think_ we have to implement this function, and return false if it's a line and there are two points, or if it's a polygon and there are 3 points (I forgot about the polygon instance):
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/211265113-3041aa9e-21a3-405a-9ed7-7c470af6a474.png)

issues.title: Order Editing - don't let features get deleted
issues.body:
In the `OrderEditing` module, players are able to delete nodes in lines/areas by right-clicking on them.

But, if we have less than two points in a line, the line disappears, and can't be redrawn. 

The `preventMarkerRemoval` flag would prevent the above, but we would need to dynamically updated it, according to if a line has two elements or not.

Steps to reproduce:
- yarn develop
- log in as MTG1
- go to Orders tab
- find `ASW Barrier`
- click to Edit document
- click to Edit locations, map will zoom in on locations
- right click on points on line to delete

We don't want user to be able to completely remove the line.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/211052735-517ab7c7-ddc0-4308-aeb7-d404c6d49922.mp4
